slides.bodyText: Commander, welcome to \nTactica: a Space Opera Your goal is to conquer this frontier sector for its BISMUTH Build an army, defend your structures, and conquer the sector
The battle is fought on a grid of squares
Three PROGENY fight for control of the BISMUTH: \u25E6 Ertrians mine it for trade \u25E6 Virix grow from it \u25E6 Sentus draw power from it
\u25E6 Each player has a Command Structure \u25E6 Capture the enemy’s Command Structure and protect your own \u25E6 Use BISMUTH to build your forces
Only Capture Units can capture BISMUTH and other structures \u25E6 Ertrian Infantry \u25E6 Virix Spore \u25E6 Sentus Blacksmith
\u25E6 Put a Capture Unit on a structure and press capture \u25E6 Each structure has 200 HP \u25E6 Capturing takes 2 turns at full health.
\u25E6 At the beginning of your turn, each controlled structure gives +100 BISMUTH \u25E6 Spend BISMUTH to build your army \u25E6 Ertrians get a 10% income bonus
\u25E6 Ertrians: Factories, Airports \u25E6 Virix: ANY owned BISMUTH tile \u25E6 Sentus: Portals

\u25E6 Click a production structure to see which units you can create this turn
\u25E6 Click on a button to create it on the production structure
\u25E6 You can’t build on a structure with a unit on top of it

\u25E6 Click on a unit to see its movement range <color=#ADD8E6>(Blue Tiles)</color>
\u25E6 Click on a <color=#ADD8E6>Blue Tile</color> to move
\u25E6 Terrain and enemies block paths

\u25E6 Enemy units in <color=#FF9999>Red Tiles</color> are attackable
\u25E6 Move adjacent by clicking a <color=#ADD8E6>Blue Tile</color> and select Attack
\u25E6 Preview damage before committing

\u25E6 Units display health (out of 100%)
\u25E6 Hurt units do less damage and capture structures slower
\u25E6 Reduce to 0% to destroy
\u25E6 Most units fight back but much weaker

\u25E6 Flying units avoid terrain
\u25E6 Virix Spores are flying units but can't attack
\u25E6 Virix Spores sacrifice themselves to capture a structure

\u25E6 Ranged units can attack at a distance but can’t move and shoot in one turn
\u25E6 <color=#ADD8E6>Blue Tiles</color> are movement range
\u25E6 <color=#FF9999>Red Lines</color> outline attack range
\u25E6 Ertrian: Ranged units & bonus income from BISMUTH \u25E6 Virix: Free spores every turn & can create units on BISMUTH \u25E6 Sentus: Bonus defense near BISMUTH
\u25E6 You're ready to command your Progeny forces \u25E6 Capture BISMUTH, outplay your enemies, and claim victory \u25E6 Go forth and conquer the sector!
